subject: Auditing and Ethics
question_text:
10. 
CA Rishu is appointed as an auditor of a manufacturing company with a 
complex supply chain, multiple inventory locations, and recently 
introduced financial reporting requirements. Some article assistants and 
an expert assigned for inventory verification are forming part of audit 
team of CA Rishu. To ensure that audit risk is reduced to an acceptably 
low level, CA Rishu is focused on developing an effective and efficient 
audit plan. Explain the benefits of adequate audit planning in the audit 
of financial statements.
